title: 회원 가입 양식 읽기: 무엇을 꼭 써야 해요?
objective: You can read a Korean sign-up form, find required and optional fields, and follow the ID, password and birth date rules.
summary: Learners read a Korean sign-up form and find the fields and rules.
note: The store name and form on this page are made up for practice. Real sign-up forms look very similar.

task.title: Read the form and answer
task.line: Use the sample form and the word list below to answer each question.

items.text: This is the name you use to log in.
Press it to see if someone already uses that ID.
items.example: 아이디를 쓰고 중복 확인을 먼저 누르세요.

items.text: This is a secret word that only you know.
Type your password again. It must be the same.
The year, month and day you were born.
The site sends this number to you by text message.
You must fill this in to sign up.

sections.heading: Reading tips
paragraphs: Look for the * mark first. Every box with * is required. Read the small text next to each box: 영문 = English letters, 소문자 = lowercase, 포함 = including, 8자 이상 = 8 or more characters, 6~12자 = 6 to 12 characters.
Write the date of birth as 8 numbers: year, month, day (for example, 19950314).

exercises: Look at the form. Write O (true) or X (false): ① 이메일을 안 써도 가입할 수 있어요. ② 비밀번호는 숫자만 써도 돼요. ③ 휴대폰 번호는 꼭 써야 해요.
Look at the ID rule on the form. Can you use this ID? Write Yes or No: ① sky_kim7 ② haneul2025 ③ Mina88
Write this date of birth the way the form asks: 1998년 11월 5일
Which box or button on the form is this? Write the Korean name: ① 3분 안에 휴대폰에 온 숫자 6개를 써요. ② 위의 칸과 똑같은 비밀번호를 써요. ③ 내 아이디를 다른 사람이 이미 쓰고 있는지 알아봐요.
Fill in the blank with 필수 or 선택: 광고 문자를 받고 싶지 않아요. 이 항목은 ____이라서 체크하지 않아도 돼요.
answers: ① O ② X ③ O
① No ② Yes ③ No
① 인증번호 ② 비밀번호 확인 ③ 중복 확인
